conviction_note: Balanced evidence: the company reiterated its FY guide on 2026-09-10 with most of Q3 visible and a 25%-of-shares short sits against calls already bid, while the name has sold three of four 2026 prints and 2025 seasonality points to a Q3 slightly under a disputed $178-182M bar. p_up 52 on a 14-point absolute move gives +0.56. The findings sum (+1.3) is larger because the squeeze and guide items are sized at full strength on their own; neither number is fitted to the other.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue consensus $178.0M / EPS $0.29 (Benzinga, https://www.benzinga.com/quote/TMDX/earnings-forecasts) vs $181.8M / EPS $0.27 and FY26 consensus $745.7M (Earnings Whispers, 2026-10-28, https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/TMDX/22402). The two sources are about 2% apart, so they count as disputed and the quarter-level findings are capped small. Company guide: FY26 revenue $737-757M ex PAD Aviation, reiterated 2026-09-10 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001756262/000119312526387960/d116447dex991.htm); adjusted operating margin cut to about 12.5-14% at Q2. H1 2026 revenue $363.9M, so H2 needs $373.1-393.1M (+22.5% to +29% y/y against H2 2025's $304.6M).
positioning_check: Short interest 8,769,040 shares, 25.29% of shares outstanding, 9.89 days to cover at the 2026-10-15 settlement, up from 7.36M (21.2%) on 2026-05-29 and rising on 3 of the last 4 settlements (equibles, https://equibles.com/stocks/tmdx/short-interest). This is a crowded short. 25-delta skew is -14.31 vol points, so calls are bid ('upside paid'). Put/call OI 0.72. Straddle implies 17.04%, but the ATM spread is 38% of mid, so treat it as indicative. Spot $68.375 is -54.5% off the 52-week high and +10% off the low; -13.45% over 20 days; -20.9% in October with no company news found; down about 6% on the print day itself (AAII, 2026-11-05).

findings.finding: On 2026-09-10, about 10 weeks into Q3 and after the August seasonal trough, TransMedics reiterated FY26 revenue guidance of $737-757M (ex PAD Aviation) and said it would update the outlook with Q3. On the Q2 call management said Q3 'started very, very strong' with July 'the highest aviation month for the business', and that the midpoint implies normal H2 sequential growth. The street's FY number ($733M at one source, $745.7M at Earnings Whispers on 10-28) sits at or below the midpoint, so a hold or narrowing at or above the low end meets or beats the street.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Aug 2026: the low end was raised and revenue beat, but the stock fell 5.28% on an EPS miss and margin-guide cut. May 2026: guide reaffirmed, EPS missed, stock -23.19%. Feb 2026: initial FY26 guide, -4.3% then +7.94%. This name has not paid for guide holds in 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: If the market believed the reiteration, the stock would not have fallen about 21% in October with no company news, and FY consensus would not sit at or below the guide midpoint. Calls are bid (skew -14), so some of the upside is in the options, but the stock price trades as if a guide cut is likely.
findings.independence: Q2 call commentary: 'started Q3 very, very strong', July record aviation month, a competitor's lost logistics account came to TMDX (vectorshift summary, https://vectorshift.ai/research/companies/transmedics-group/earnings/2026-q2, AI-generated summary, not a primary transcript). The September 8-K is a separate document from the Q2 call. Director David Weill bought shares on 2026-09-11 at $81.63 (stocktitan), filed separately.

findings.finding: Applying TransMedics' own 2025 pattern (Q3 2025 $143.8M / Q2 2025 $157.4M = 0.914) to Q2 2026's $189.9M gives about $173.6M for Q3 2026, 2.5-4.5% below the $178.0-181.8M consensus. 2026 has tracked 2025's seasonality so far: Q1 $174.0M (+21%), Q2 +9% sequential against +9.7% in 2025.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 (seasonal dip, U.S. revenue -9% sequential): stock +1.09%. Q1 2026 revenue and EPS miss: -23.19%. Q2 2026 revenue beat with EPS miss: -5.28%. Revenue misses have been punished hard; revenue beats with EPS misses were still sold.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus at $178-182M implies a Q2-to-Q3 dip of only 4-6%, against 8.6% last year. If the street had applied last year's seasonality, Q3 consensus would sit near $174M. Offsets: record July aviation, logistics share gain from a competitor account, and the inference is from the company's own history, not a counted number. The bar is disputed, so this is capped small.
findings.independence: Q4 2025 release for FY2025 quarterly revenue (https://www.barchart.com/story/news/397577/transmedics-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-financial-results). Shares the Q2 2026 release with no other finding. Partly contradicted by the 'very strong' July commentary in finding 1, which is why it is small.

findings.finding: Short interest is 8.77M shares, 25.3% of shares outstanding and 9.9 days to cover at the 2026-10-15 settlement, rising steadily since May. With the stock 10% off its 52-week low, down about 21% in October and about 6% on the print day, any print that avoids a guide cut is set up for a covering rally.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: May 2025 +19.64% and Jul 2025 +10.46% came on beats into an elevated short. In 2026 shorts have been paid on three of four prints (-23.19, -5.28, -4.3).
findings.why_not_priced: The skew (-14.3, calls bid) shows part of the squeeze is priced in the options. The stock's slide and rising short interest show the cash market is leaning short, not positioned for a non-negative outcome.
findings.independence: Baseline skew -14.31 and put/call OI 0.72 (sealed baseline). AAII 2026-11-05 shows the stock down 5.8% intraday into the print (https://www.aaii.com/investingideas/article/554060-why-transmedics-group-inc8217s-tmdx-stock-is-down-608).

findings.finding: Profit-line risk: at Q2 the adjusted operating margin guide was cut to about 12.5-14% from about 16% (OCS Kidney and Gen 3.0 spend; R&D roughly doubled y/y to $31.6M), H2 gross margin was guided to about 59%, and Q2 EPS of $0.44 missed $0.50. Q3 EPS consensus is $0.27-0.29, down about 59% y/y. This name has been sold on EPS misses even when revenue beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: EPS misses: May 2026 -23.19%, Aug 2026 -5.28% despite a revenue beat and a guide-low-end raise.
findings.why_not_priced: The EPS bar has already been reset sharply lower ($0.27), which works against this finding. What is not in the price is a first print under a new CFO from GE HealthCare (effective 2026-09-21), whose cost and PAD Aviation consolidation treatment are unknown. Shrunk for the crowded short.
findings.independence: Q2 2026 release: operating income $23.7M vs $36.6M, opex $89.5M vs $60.0M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001756262/000119312526332767/tmdx-ex99_1.htm).

findings.finding: Director David Weill bought 1,336 shares at $81.63 on 2026-09-11 (Form 4 filed 2026-09-14), the day after the guide reiteration. The purchase is small, about $109k.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public, and the stock has since fallen about 16% below the purchase price, so it carries little information. It is filed because it is sourced.
findings.independence: Supports finding 1 timing but is a separate filing.

findings.finding: Competitor XVIVO's Q3 2026 report (2026-10-22): Thoracic +51% organic, the FDA has received the PMA for its Heart Assist Transport, US PRESERVE continued-access enrollment was expanded, and CE marks are in Europe. This adds competition for OCS Heart; Abdominal (liver) grew only +12%, so liver, TMDX's largest organ, is less contested by XVIVO.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Competition headlines drove 2024 downgrades (Needham); no 2026 print has turned on heart competition.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a peer's print that landed after TMDX last spoke, so TMDX has not addressed it; questions on the call are likely. This is a proxy: XVIVO's US heart is still trial-stage, and it is net of TMDX's liver-led mix.

findings.finding: Analyst flow into the print is mixed: Barclays initiated Overweight in early October, Canaccord trimmed its target to $94 from $95 on 2026-10-07, and AAII counts two unnamed downgrades and no upgrades in the month to 2026-11-04.
findings.why_not_priced: Public; the downgrades are unnamed so their content is unknown. Net zero.
findings.independence: Barclays initiation and Canaccord PT from the stocktitan/aggregator search (https://www.stocktitan.net/overview/TMDX/), not verified at a primary source.

findings.finding: On the Q2 call management expected the CHOPS-related IDE supplement (ENHANCE Part B / DENOVO trial revenue, excluded from guidance) to be approved 'late Q3 or early Q4', with trial revenue 'late in the fourth quarter and definitely into 2027'. No approval announcement was found by 2026-11-05, so the status is likely disclosed on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print turned on the trial timeline.
findings.why_not_priced: The timeline is public but the status is not; an approval would support the Q4 ramp needed for the guide. Either way, slippage or approval is small against FY guidance that excludes it. The source is an AI summary of the call.
findings.independence: Q2 release confirms guidance excludes ENHANCE Part B and DENOVO revenue (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001756262/000119312526332767/tmdx-ex99_1.htm).

outside_window.finding: The CFO said on the Q2 call that 2027 guidance comes with Q4 results (February 2027), so a full 2027 guide is not expected in this window. Any early 2027 framing on this call would be upside to abs_move.
The FDA decision on XVIVO's heart PMA (US competition for OCS Heart) is dated well after the window.

baseline_tension: What I found leans slightly positive, in line with the call-bid skew and against the -13% 20-day run-up; the name's 2026 habit of selling prints keeps p_up near 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (verified fact is not a reaction): guide-hold finding cut from +1.5 to +1.0 because the Aug 2026 low-end raise was still sold -5.3%.
Lesson 6 (disputed bar, $178.0M vs $181.8M): seasonality-shortfall finding capped, -1.0 to -0.6.
Lesson 7 (crowded short, 25% of shares, call skew): EPS/margin negative shrunk from -1.0 to -0.8; p_up left at 52.
Lesson 5: the unexplained October drawdown is not filed as evidence either way; XVIVO kept as a small proxy.
